breakdown.description: M_w = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i; use M_w = Σ(N_i M_i^2) / Σ(N_i M_i); the setup substitutes the number-average formula while asking for the weight-average molecular weight.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly used the incorrect formula M_w = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i, which is the number-average molecular weight formula, not the weight-average formula. The correct weight-average formula is M_w = Σ(N_i M_i²) / Σ(N_i M_i). The agent repeated the error from the incomplete prompt rather than applying the correct formula, arriving at ~99,177 g/mol instead of the correct weight-average value.
